verdict.rationale: The only affirmative evidence of data landing in a warehouse is a one-line integrations-page claim that mParticle connects customer data to 'data warehousing solutions with just a few clicks.' Warehouse Sync is documented, but it runs the opposite direction: it ingests from Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift and Databricks into mParticle, so it is not credited here. missing for 10: documented outbound warehouse/lake destinations (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, S3), export of raw events and profiles specifically, user-controlled sync schedule, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, raw events and profiles land in my own warehouse or lake (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, S3) on a schedule I control

citations.quote:
